children: Brunello Cucinelli is likely to report robust sales for the third quarter, among the strongest in the luxury industry, Equita SIM analyst Paola Carboni says. The analyst expects the Italian high-end fashion house to post turnover of 371 million euros, more than 12% higher on year at constant currency. These assumptions support the upper end of the company's full-year guidance of an increase in revenue between 10% and 11% at constant exchange rates, Carboni writes in a note. "We think they also leave a slight upside room," she adds. The company has a much more visible growth profile than peers, the analyst adds. Equita SIM confirms its buy rating on the stock. Shares are up 1.8%. (andrea.figueras@wsj.com)
